talents.name: Improved Heroic Strike
talents.description: Reduces the cost of your Heroic Strike ability by 3 Rage.

talents.name: Deflection
talents.description: Increases your Parry chance by 5%.

talents.name: Improved Rend
talents.description: Increases the Bleed damage done by your Rend ability by 35%.

talents.name: Improved Charge
talents.description: Increases the Rage generated by your Charge ability by 6.

talents.name: Improved Tactical Mastery
talents.description: Tactical Mastery lets you retain up to an additional 15 Rage when you change stances.

talents.name: Improved Overpower
talents.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Overpower ability by 50%.

talents.name: Anger Management
talents.description: Generates 1 Rage every 3 sec while in combat, and reduces Rage loss while out of combat by 30%.

talents.name: Deep Wounds
talents.description: Your critical strikes cause your opponent to Bleed, dealing 60% of your melee weapon's average damage over 12 sec.

talents.name: Spearing Strike
talents.description: A brutal attack that deals 40% weapon damage. Deals an additional 80% weapon damage against Giants, Dragonkin, and mounted targets. Mounted targets are dismounted.

talents.name: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization
talents.description: Increases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by 3%.

talents.name: Impale
talents.description: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your abilities by 20%.

talents.name: Bloodthrill
talents.description: Your melee attacks against targets afflicted by your Rend have a 10% chance to activate your Overpower ability for 1 attack on your current target. Lasts 6 sec.

talents.name: Sweeping Strikes
talents.description: Your next 5 melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent.

talents.name: Weaponmaster
talents.description:
Gives your melee weapon attacks a benefit depending on the weapon.

 Axe/Polearm: Increases your
 critical strike chance by 5%.

 Mace/Staff: Your attacks ignore
 15% of your target's armor.

 Sword: Your successful melee 
 attacks have a 5% chance to 
 trigger an extra attack on the 
 target.

talents.name: Improved Slam
talents.description: Reduces the global cooldown and cast time of your Slam ability by 0.50 sec. In addition, Slam no longer interrupts your melee swing time.

talents.name: Improved Hamstring
talents.description: Gives your Hamstring ability a 15% chance to immobilize the target for 5 sec.

talents.name: Mortal Strike
talents.description: A vicious strike that deals weapon damage plus 85 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec.

talents.name: Booming Voice
talents.description: Increases the radius of your Battle Shout and Demoralizing Shout abilities by 50%.

talents.name: Cruelty
talents.description: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with melee attacks by 5%.

talents.name: Iron Will
talents.description: Reduces the duration of Stun and Fear effects inflicted on you by 15%.

talents.name: Unbridled Wrath
talents.description: Gives you a 60% chance to generate 1 additional Rage when you deal melee damage with a weapon. This effect is increased to 2 Rage for two-handed weapons.

talents.name: Improved Cleave
talents.description: Reduces the Rage cost of your Cleave ability by 3.

talents.name: Piercing Howl
talents.description: Causes all nearby enemies to be Dazed, reducing movement speed by 50% for 6 sec.

talents.name: Blood Craze
talents.description: Regenerates 3% of your total Health over 6 sec after being the victim of a critical strike, dealing damage with Bloodthirst, or suffering more than 20% of your maximum Health from a single attack.

talents.name: Boundless Rage
talents.description: Increases your maximum Rage by 30.

talents.name: Dual Wield Specialization
talents.description: Increases your off-hand weapon damage by 25%, off-hand Rage generation by 100%, and chance to hit with off-hand attacks by 10%.

talents.name: Raging Blows
talents.description: Causes your Whirlwind to also strike with your off-hand weapon, and reduces the Rage cost of your Cleave ability by 2.

talents.name: Enrage
talents.description: Gives you a 30% chance to deal 10% increased Physical damage for 12 sec after being the victim of any damaging attack.

talents.name: Improved Execute
talents.description: Reduces the Rage cost of your Execute ability by 5.

talents.name: Precision
talents.description: Improves your chance to hit by 3%.

talents.name: Death Wish
talents.description: When activated, increases your Physical damage done by 20% and makes you immune to Fear effects, but increases all damage you take by 5%. Lasts 30 sec.

talents.name: Improved Intercept
talents.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Intercept ability by 10 sec.

talents.name: Improved Berserker Rage
talents.description: Your Berserker Rage ability will instantly generate 10 Rage and has a 100% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when activated.

talents.name: Flurry
talents.description: Increases your melee attack speed by 25% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.

talents.name: Bloodthirst
talents.description: Instantly attack the target causing damage equal to 35% of your Attack Power plus 30 and increasing your movement speed by 10% for 10 sec.

talents.name: Shield Specialization
talents.description: Increases your chance to Block attacks with your shield by 5% and grants you a 100% chance to generate 5 Rage when you Block.

talents.name: Anticipation
talents.description: Increases your Defense Skill by 20.

talents.name: Improved Bloodrage
talents.description: Increases all the Rage generated by your Bloodrage ability by 50%.

talents.name: Toughness
talents.description: Increases your Armor value from items by 10%.

talents.name: Improved Thunder Clap
talents.description: Reduces the Rage cost of your Thunder Clap ability by 6.

talents.name: Last Stand
talents.description: When activated, this ability temporarily grants you 30% of your maximum health for 20 sec. After the effect expires, the health is lost.

talents.name: Master of Defense
talents.description: Grants you a 100% chance to generate 5 Rage when you Dodge or Parry while a shield is equipped.

talents.name: Improved Revenge
talents.description: Increases damage dealt by your Revenge ability by 60%.

talents.name: Defiance
talents.description: Increases all threat generated in Defensive stance by an additional 15% while a shield is equipped.

talents.name: Improved Sunder Armor
talents.description: Reduces the Rage cost of your Sunder Armor ability by 3.

talents.name: Improved Disarm
talents.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Disarm ability by 20 secs.

talents.name: Vanguard
talents.description: Your Charge ability is now usable while in Defensive Stance.

talents.name: Improved Shield Wall
talents.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Shield Wall ability by 11 min.

talents.name: Concussion Blow
talents.description: Stuns the target for 5 sec.

talents.name: Improved Shield Bash
talents.description: Gives your Shield Bash ability a 100% chance to Silence the target for 3 sec.

talents.name: Bastion
talents.description: Increases all damage you deal by 10% while a shield is equipped.

talents.name: Focused Rage
talents.description: Reduces the Rage cost of your offensive abilities by 3.

talents.name: Shield Slam
talents.description: Slam the target with your shield, causing 421 to 439 damage, increased by your Block Value, and has a 50% chance of dispelling 1 magic effect on the target. Causes a very high amount of threat.
